lines.rom: mamgala ki seva suna meri deva hatha jora tere dvara khare pana supari dhvaja nariyala le jvala teri bhemta dhare suna jagadambe kara na vilambe samtana ke bhandara bhare samtana pratipali sada khusahali maiya jai kali kalyana kare
buddhi vidhata tu jaga mata mera karaja siddha kare carana kamala ka liya asara sarana tumhari ana pare jaba jaba bhira pari bhaktana para taba taba aya sahaya kare
bara bara taim saba jaga mohayo taruni rupa anupa dhare mata hokara putra khilave kahim bharya bhoga kare santana sukhadai sada sahai santa khare jayakara kare

brahma visnu mahesa sahasaphana lie bhemta dena tere dvara khare atala simhasana baithi meri mata sira sone ka chatra phire vara saniscara kumkuma barano jaba lumkara para hukuma kare
khadga khappara trisula hatha lie rakta bija ko bhasma kare sumbha nisumbha ko ksana mem mare mahisasura ko pakara dale adita vari adi bhavani jana apane ka kasta hare
